newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Seven says trading ahead, but tough.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Seven says trading ahead, but tough.

text.p: Television operator Seven Network Managing Director Gary Rice said on Thursday the company was trading ahead of the same time a year ago, but the increase was not substantial and that conditions were very tough.
"Whilst it's not bad or grim, it's just hard work," Rice told reporters after a Securities Institute of Australia briefing.
"It's all very last minute, there's not a lot of confidence indicated in forward billings," he said.
When asked by reporters how Seven was travelling so far this financial year, Rice said: "Fairly well, although the market is very tough, very tight."
When asked if Seven was ahead of last year, he said: "Yes...not substantially."
"I know in this town everyone is struggling and I think it's pretty much the case across Australia," he said.
"I think, unfortunately, there is not a lot of confidence out there in the community at the moment."
